race_tendency.note: テキスト傾向データ。特徴量化は困難

extended_form.note: 馬柱5走表はjra_races_full.csvと完全重複。新規データなし

nar_premium.note: 中央モデル優先。NAR用は将来実装

time_1f_last.note: 追い切りのラスト1ハロン

training_intensity.note: 馬なり/強め/一杯のカテゴリ変数

speed_index_max.note: netkeiba独自のタイム指数。1000=該当なし、1100前後が平均

speed_index_avg5.note: 直近5走の平均タイム指数

speed_index_run1.note: 前走のタイム指数。prev_finishより情報量多い

recommendations: speed_index_max (最高指数): netkeiba独自指数。カバレッジ高く最有望
speed_index_avg5 (5走平均): 安定した能力指標
time_1f_last (ラスト1F): 追い切りの末脚を直接測定。最も有望な新規特徴量
training_intensity (強度): 馬なり/強め/一杯で調教内容を反映。エンコード必要
time_6f (CW 6Fタイム): CW調教の全体タイム。坂路馬はカバレッジ0%
stable_comment_score: 厩舎の主観評価。ノイズが多いが情報は新規
not_recommended: time_5f: time_4fと高相関(情報重複)
training_course_type: has_wood/sakaro_trainingで概ねカバー済み

priority_1_immediate.reason: High coverage (86-99%), completely new information, no overlap with existing 87 features
priority_1_immediate.expected_impact: HIGH - speed index captures ability in a single number that combines time+weight+course

priority_2_moderate.reason: Moderate coverage (27-93%), some noise but unique signal

priority_3_low.reason: Low coverage or high correlation with priority 1 features
priority_3_low.expected_impact: LOW - likely redundant with higher priority features

index_max_vs_existing.prev_finish: Partial (both measure ability but different angle: placement vs time-adjusted)
index_max_vs_existing.prev_odds_log: Medium (market assessment correlates with speed figures)

index_run1_vs_existing.prev_finish: Medium (前走着順 vs 前走指数 - similar race but different metric)
index_run1_vs_existing.prev_last3f: Medium (上がり3F reflects speed but for one segment)
index_run1_vs_existing.verdict: Partially overlapping but index is more comprehensive (adjusts for weight/course/pace)

time_1f_last_vs_existing.wood_best_4f_filled: Low (4F overall vs 1F last - different training phase)
time_1f_last_vs_existing.verdict: New information. Measures finishing kick in training.

retraining_plan.step1: Collect 2024-2025 full data (speed index + training times) for all races
retraining_plan.step2: Merge with jra_races_full.csv by race_id + umaban mapping
retraining_plan.step3: Add priority_1 features to Pattern A feature list (67 → 70)
retraining_plan.step4: Retrain with walk-forward validation, compare AUC/ROI
